title: LC-MS3 Proteomics Data Acquisition
author: Ruiqi Jian
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf6bjran
materials: Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer
Proteomic samples were analyzed on a Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer coupled online with a Waters 2D liquid chromatography (Waters MClass 2DnLC).
The acquired raw data were processed with the Proteome Discoverer 2.1 (Thermo).

steps.title: Perform First Dimension Reverse Phase Chromatography
steps.instruction: Separate peptides at high pH using a Waters Xbridge C18 column (300µm x 5 cm, 5.0µm).

substeps.instruction: Prepare mobile phases: buffer A (20mM ammonium formate in water at pH10) and buffer B (100% acetonitrile).
Set flow rate to 2 µl/min.

steps.title: Perform Second Dimension Orthogonal Separation
steps.instruction: Separate peptides at low pH using a trap column and an analytical column.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mobile phases: buffer A (0.1% formic acid in water) and buffer B (0.1% formic acid in acetonitrile).
Use a Waters Acquity UPLC M-class Trap 2D Symmetry C18 column (5µm, 180µmx20mm) to trap peptides.
Separate peptides using an in-house packed analytical column (360µm OD/100µm ID/15µm tip ID x 28cm length, packed with Sepex GP-C18 resin 1.8um, 120A).
Apply a gradient from 5% to 40% buffer B over 180 minutes at a flow rate of 600 nl/min.
Heat the analytical column to 45 °C.

steps.title: Configure Mass Spectrometer Ionization
steps.instruction: Ionize eluted peptides in positive mode via flex ion source.

substeps.instruction: Operate the source at 1.8-2.2 kV.
Heat the ion transfer tube to 275 °C.

steps.title: Acquire MS Data in Data Dependent Mode
steps.instruction: Perform full MS scans and precursor fragmentation.

substeps.instruction: Acquire full MS scans in the Orbitrap mass analyzer from 400-1500 m/z with a resolution of 120,000.
Isolate precursors with an isolation window of 0.7 m/z.
Fragment precursors using CID at 35% energy in the ion trap in rapid mode.
Set AGC target to 1e4 and maximum injection time to 100ms.

steps.title: Perform MS3 Analysis
steps.instruction: Select and fragment the top 8 fragment ions for MS3 analysis.

substeps.instruction: Isolate the top 8 fragment ions with an m/z window of 1.6.
Fragment ions with HCD at 65% energy.
Detect resulting fragments in the Orbitrap at 60,000 resolution.
Set maximum injection time to 150ms or until the AGC target value of 1e5 is reached.

steps.title: Process Data and Search Database
steps.instruction: Perform database search and filter results based on specified tolerances and modifications.

substeps.instruction: Set mass tolerance to 10ppm for precursor ions and 0.6 Dalton for fragment ions.
Set cysteine carbamidomethylation as a static modification.
Set acetylation at protein N-terminus, methionine oxidation, and TMT at peptide N-terminus and Lysine as dynamic modifications.
Allow up to two missed cleavages for trypsin digestion.
Consider only unique peptides with a minimum length of 6 amino acids for protein identification.
Set peptide false discovery rate (FDR) to less than 1%.
Exclude spectra with more than 50% interference for quantitative analysis.
